package storage

import "context"

// Fixture for TestCtxThreading_ScannerFixture. Never compiled (*.go.txt).

type Storage interface {
	WidgetStore
}

type WidgetStore interface {
	// GetWidget is the safe form: a leading context.Context (unnamed is fine in an interface).
	GetWidget(context.Context, string) (string, error)
	// DeleteWidget is the planted violation: no leading context.
	DeleteWidget(id string) error
}
